title: A joint low-calcium/high-phosphorus hinge did not establish incremental PTH prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed serum calcium–phosphorus hinge did not establish incremental log PTH prediction beyond flexible conventional measurements and their product. In NHANES2003–2004(n=3773)and2005–2006(n=3783), target weighted MSE gain was 0.0000277 (400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval -0.0063897 to 0.0038076); source CV gain was -0.0008897. These are separately sampled releases within one survey program, previously used in author research, not untouched external-cohort confirmation. The result is not equivalence.
